name: Lifecycle and updates
notes: Install, login, quit, single instance, data folder, updates

features.feature: The DMG installs on a fresh Mac; first run chooses the data folder (or the default) and downloads a speech model (now or later; an interrupted download fails cleanly; the model in use can't be removed)
Echo starts at login when set to, and doesn't when not
Quit saves the window's notes first, ends every process, and Echo starts normally again (`echoctl app start`)
Only one Echo runs at a time
Changing the data folder restarts Echo on the new one and leaves the old one alone
Notifications come from Echo and open its window; "Update available" asks to install
An update is offered, installs after saving and quitting, keeps everything, and never while a call records; on the newest version nothing is offered
Closing the window keeps Echo in the menu bar and the Dock (unless Hide from the Dock); a Dock click opens it again
